cards.imageAlt: Figure 4，用于本话题的看图描述和问答

cards.audioText: Can you describe what is happening in the picture?
cards.audioTextZh: 你能描述图中发生了什么吗？
cards.referenceText: It snowed at the airport. There is a parked airplane and two de-icing vehicles on the apron. Some staff members are operating the de-icing vehicles, and some other people are standing around. The airplane is under de-icing procedure.
cards.referenceTextZh: 好的。机场下雪了。停机坪上有一架飞机和两辆除冰车。一些工作人员在操作除冰车，另外一些人站在飞机周围。飞机正在接受除冰。

cards.referenceText: Yes, I have such kind of experience. Last winter, it had three heavy snows in Beijing. Unfortunately, I experienced one of them. The airport was covered with 4cm of snow and our aircraft were all covered with snow. I had to wait in the long queue for de-icing. It took us one hour to wait in the aircraft. Finally, we took off safely after two hours' delay.
cards.referenceTextZh: 我有类似经历。去年冬天，北京下了三场大雪，我不幸遭遇了其中一场。机场被4厘米厚的雪覆盖，我们的飞机上全都是雪。我不得不排长队等待除冰，排队令我在飞机里等待了一小时。飞机延误了两小时，最后安全起飞了。

cards.audioText: Under what condition will the airplane be prohibited to take off in winter?
cards.audioTextZh: 在什么情况下飞机禁止在冬天起飞？
cards.referenceText: China Civil Aviation Regulations (CCAR) prohibit takeoff when snow, ice, or frost is adhering to wings, propellers, control surfaces, engine outlets, and other critical surfaces of the aircraft.
cards.referenceTextZh: 中国民航规章中禁止飞机在机翼、螺旋桨、操纵面、引擎或飞机其它操纵面上在有雪、结冰、结霜的情况下起飞。

cards.audioText: What training have you had for cold weather operations?
cards.audioTextZh: 你参加过哪些寒冷天气飞行相关训练？
cards.referenceText: We have season-changing training for cold weather operations every autumn, including anti-icing and de-icing procedures and thunderstorm circumnavigation training.
cards.referenceTextZh: 每年秋季会参加换季训练，内容与寒冷天气飞行相关，包括防冰、除冰程序和雷雨绕飞。

cards.audioText: Do you have special training for flying in the North Pole regions?
cards.audioTextZh: 你参加过在北极地区飞行的特殊训练吗？
cards.referenceText: Yes, we have. North Pole regions are special operation routes, so before flights, pilots need to get some special information about that region. Our company has a Special Operation Manual, which verifies the detailed requirements for North Pole region operation.
cards.referenceTextZh: 参加过，北极航线是特殊运行航路，所以在飞行前，飞行员需要了解北极地区的特殊信息。我的公司有特殊运行手册，其中对北极地区操作有详细的要求。

cards.audioText: What would you do if you encountered severe hail during flight?
cards.audioTextZh: 如果你在飞行中遭遇强冰雹你会怎样做？
cards.referenceText: If I encountered severe hail during flight, I would ask ATC for deviation to avoid that area, and I would also inform the passengers to fasten their seat belts.
cards.referenceTextZh: 如果我在飞行中遭遇强冰雹，我会向ATC申请偏离避开冰雹区域，并且我会通知乘客系紧安全带。

cards.audioText: If you were holding for takeoff and a flight attendant reported that there was a buildup of snow on the wings, what would you do?
cards.audioTextZh: 如果你正在等待起飞，乘务人员报告机翼有积雪，你会怎样做？
cards.referenceText: In this case, I will report the situation to ATC and request to go back to the apron for de-icing. Because I can’t take off with snow on the wings.
cards.referenceTextZh: 如果是这种情况，我会将情况报告给ATC并要求回停机坪除冰，因为机翼有积雪飞机无法起飞。

cards.audioText: What factors would you consider to ensure flight safety in icing conditions?
cards.audioTextZh: 在结冰条件下，你会考虑哪些因素来保证飞行安全？
cards.referenceText: In snow weather, de-icing procedure is usually carried out before departure to ensure that all control surfaces can be operated normally. Before flight, we first check the performance of the aircraft and do a walk-around inspection. If snow or ice is built on the surface of the aircraft, we must execute de-icing procedure. Under icing conditions, we must reduce taxi speed and operate the aircraft with caution.
cards.referenceTextZh: 雪天时出发前要进行除冰流程，以确保所有的操纵面正常运行。在飞行前，首先要检查飞机性能并做绕机检查。飞机表面有雪或冰时必须执行除冰流程。在结冰条件下必须要降低滑行速度，并且小心驾驶飞机。
